reviews.title: Awful customer service
reviews.text: Horrible customer service lost a passport on board and they never even tried to assist me in getting it returned. Emailed them countless times and never got an answer and they won’t even answer a phone call had to call security to get them to retrieve it. Horrible would not recommend
reviews.author: Jack P

reviews.title: Most bizarre checking in demand
reviews.text: On 25 October 2023 I was booked to fly from Quebec City to Newark, via Toronto. The young woman checking me in insisted that I provide her with a photograph of the place I would be staying at in Newark! I offered to give her the address where I’d be staying in New York, but she wasn’t interested. It was a photo or I wasn’t going anywhere. Things got a little heated and I asked to see her manager. She did something on her mobile, then without a word printed the boarding passes and gestured for the next people to come forward. When I got to security I was asked if I was aware that the airline had nominated me for a full security check. Clearly the young woman sent word that I was a suspicious character. I and my luggage was given the full works, barring a strip search. To add to this, my plane to Toronto was delayed so I missed my connecting flight to Newark! Instead go getting home by 8pm I arrived at about 11pm.
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: 2 flights, both the same, not nice.
reviews.text: 2 flights with Porter this month, I do not recommend this airline. We flew ‘economy plus’, as part of a joint Air Transat booking. Both journeys included curt and unfriendly staff, the Wi-Fi didn’t work, and I certainly didn’t fancy asking for help from the head steward, who seemed dismissive and impatient. We were delayed an hour owing to some issue with passenger numbers/seat allocations - none of us were quite sure why it took so long! We observed that there seemed similar delays going on with another flight boarding in Toronto, which seemed odd. The food was really horrible, either too spicy, too salty, strange mixtures that we weren’t quite sure about, all served quite randomly in brown boxes! Nope, not again!
reviews.author: Lay_dee_jayne

reviews.title: No refund for flight cancelled - disaster
reviews.text: Flight cancelled due to weather conditions. Re-scheduling suggestion didn't work for me, so I cancelled the booking and requested a refund. Horrible customer service, took 30 days for first review. They refused to give me the money, only a credit. But I am a foreigner... not planning to use Porter anymore, and don't have friends in Canada to transfer the credit. So the money stays with Porter, who didn't provide the service, that blames the weather, but I am the one who got screwed. Seems a thieves' practice. Case 596806
reviews.author: andresilveira3

reviews.title: Never use PORTER !
reviews.text: Got to Montreal from Quebec City. Flight got delayed, then purely cancelled. We got back to the staff who did not help. Reason given : weather conditions. All other companies flew though. The staff was very rude, had a different reply to travelers according to their case, no refund. A lady got refunded because she threatened to sue the company. The man there clearly said : Just for you, keep it quiet, so other passengers would not know she got a refund. Passengers were left not having plan B, striving to find a solution. We finally could run and catch a night bus to go to Toronto (7:30 hours long) in full stress not knowing if we could get our flight the ne t morning from YYZ to SXM). Cost us the carry on price on Porter (that we paid while checking in) , 50 CA Dollars for the taxi to the bus station and 200 CA dollars for the bus. Nothing except incompetence, rudeness. Will never use again, nor recommend. I chose a rate of 1 because there was not 0.
reviews.author: Catherine M

reviews.title: Terrible customer service and seats that are as comfortable as plywood
reviews.text: Whaaat? No standby policy?!? Forced to wait as 3 flights departed to destination with multiple empty seats available. Oh, but wait....I could have paid more than the cost of the ticket for a change fee to get on one of them. That's helpful in building customer loyalty. Seats are crap. Very little webbing and you are basically sitting on an aluminum frame for the duration of your Dash 8 flight. Nice job you clowns
reviews.author: Da P

reviews.title: Delayed again...
reviews.text: Porter never changes: flights are delayed because of lateness of arrival flight from another location... Cannot be trusted even with full fares..
reviews.author: Laurent M

reviews.title: Very Poor Travel experience roundtrip from Toronto Halifax - not feeling like a valued customer this trip.
reviews.text: While going from Toronto, departure airport changed without notice or proper communication. We would have missed our flight had we not checked again on the morning of our flight. In a taxi enroute had to detour because no alert sent about change. Returning yesterday from Halifax total of 3 delays poorly communicated. Final delay announced once all were boarded awaiting take off. This situation could have been made lessa frustrating had there been timely and direct communication. There are things that are within control of airline that could have made this less hectic and frustrating. I incurred extra costs because of delays and had they been more forthcoming with info it would have allowed customers to adjust plans making it less frustrating. People with connecting flight disregarded - making me reconsidered if I would use in those situations as they received little help to sort out travel plans. I have had far better experiences and felt like I was a valued and cared for customer - however not this time. I was not able to rely on good service.
reviews.author: Anamika B

reviews.title: WORST TRAVEL EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: This company is the worst I have ever seen. Extremely poor customer service. I missed my flight because of them. They have changed gates without advising. I still arrived before the time flight takes off and they still did not accept to let me in. They refused to change my flight and said since I booked economy it’s not their problem. They wanted to rebook from scratch. The airplanes are extremely tiny and uncomfortable. If I can give 0 star I would. NEVER AGAIN!!!!
reviews.author: Hannah

reviews.title: First Experience with Porter Airlines
reviews.text: I had a great experience flying Porter Airlines for the first time recently. The aircraft was roomy, the staff were pleasant and the onboard service great. Although I was skeptical at first as I had never heard of them but after this experience, I will definitely fly Porter Airlines again. Thanks for getting me there on time and as expected!
reviews.author: Lynda N

reviews.title: Never fly with Porter airlines!
reviews.text: We were flying out at 1610 and got notice at 1530 that flight was delayed and leaving at 1630. So we arrived at the Porter counter at 1530, an hour before the flight and no one was at the counter. Their website outlines that check-in/baggage drop-off closes 30 mins before the flight leaves. However, there was no one at the counter and no employees to be seen anywhere. We proceeded to airport information, hoping they could call the airline and notify them to come and check our bag, but they could not get ahold of them. We called Porter directly as we were still at the airport and now our flight was delayed again to 1650. We were on hold for 40 mins and they were brutal. They could not help us at all. Recognizing that once we got on the phone, our flight was still not leaving for another 30 mins, we knew that they would not be able to check our bag, and we could not go through security with it. So we asked if they could put us on a flight the next day (there were 4), knowing that there would be empty seats on one of those. They refused. They would rather have empty seats on their flight, than the customers who had paid for the flight and couldn't get on, because their employees weren't there. We asked if they would honour the return flight if we got there, and they could not guarantee that either, because we were considered 'no-shows'. We were not 'no-shows'. We were there but they had no one at their counter to check our bag, despite us being there 60 mins before the scheduled
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Porter won't refund a flight they made me miss and made me buy 2000$ Air Canada tickets
reviews.text: Porter said we could go from Fredericton to Ottawa to Toronto. The Porter flight to Ottawa was delayed getting to us, delayed on the tarmac and had a longer flight time than advertised. This caused us to miss the Porter flight by 5 mins. We could see the next flight pulling away from our delayed flight. The Porter reps at the airport wouldn't even try to get the Ottawa to Toronto plane to wait. They knew the flight was delayed and that 6 people were delayed in getting to that flight. Will be fighting this for weeks. Don't fly Porter unless you want to miss your flight and have you money stolen. We were forced to buy 2000$ Air Canada tickets to make our last flight on time. Porter is garbage.
reviews.author: Matty G

reviews.title: Don’t fly Porter
reviews.text: We live outside DC and booked a weekend trip to Toronto. It’s one thing that Porter cancelled the outbound flight when boarding was supposed to start. But after that they took a month and a half to get back to us regarding ticket refund and compensation for the hotel reservation we had to cancel, and their answer so that’s the whole thing is apparently our problem. Not a dime back. Shameless doesn’t begin to describe it. Don’t fly Porter!
reviews.author: David M

reviews.title: Best airline experience in 20 years!
reviews.text: From the moment we borded ( on time!) we’re offered preferential seating on the immaculate, new jet, to the friendly staff and on board complimentary and paid for food, we were impressed. The new Porter jets are gorgeous! Worth every penny , and they were the cheapest!!!
reviews.author: brit_gill

reviews.title: Bear service- reliable, ontime, friendly. My favourite airline
reviews.text: Porter is friendly, efficient, on time and will even leave early if everyone is there. Great flights every time
reviews.author: Siekierskice

reviews.title: A bad travel experience was made much worse by incompetent staff at the airport.
reviews.text: I could have almost driven from Ottawa to Toronto AND BACK in the time this trip eventually took me door to door. And it did not have to have happened. Porter's planes were there but Porter's airport team were not able to get me and other passengers on them. And in the final insult our eventual takeoff was delayed a further 45 minutes sorting out an issue with an off-duty Porter staff person who had got on our flight but did not appear in the flight manifest so the crew could not get a match with the number of seats filled.
reviews.author: N S

reviews.title: Worst customer service ever.
reviews.text: Porter cancelled our plane due to a aircraft malfunction, then refused to book us onto the soonest flight (Porter or any other airline). Instead they tried to have us leave at a later flight which would have us miss day’s worth of work, and offered no compensation. Not only that, but the flight attendants were rude, lacking compassion, and constantly flirting with the pilot while we were stuck and anxious to get home. Unprofessional in all accounts. Would not ever travel with Porter again. Worst flight experience of my life.
reviews.author: Guide374056

reviews.title: Do NOT choose Porter Airlines
reviews.text: I would most definitely NOT recommend Porter to anyone. I am a frequent business traveler and have never experienced such poor customer service as I have with Porter. My flight from Boston to Ottawa was cancelled initially due to weather - this happens and I completely understand. They rebooked me on a flight the following morning so I had to get a hotel for the night. The following morning the flight was cancelled due to their computers (which seem to go down A LOT by the way!). They then rebooked me on a flight that evening that was again cancelled due to fog. Now, all other airlines were flying but Porter could not because they only have turbo props which apparently can't fly in the fog. They rebooked me for the NEXT day (now two days after I was supposed to get in) and after waiting at the gate for any opportunity to get on a flight, I managed to squeeze on after a total of 21 hours of delays. When I submitted a request for compensation, I was told that the number of minutes of delay for circumstances outside their control (999 minutes) was greater than the minutes of delay within their control (578 minutes) and therefore, my request did not qualify for compensation. EVEN THOUGH ON THEIR WEBSITE THEY STATE YOU QUALIFY FOR COMPENSATION AFTER 180 minutes of delay for reasons within their control. They wouldn't even pay for my hotel or meal expenses that I incurred as a result... Customer service was horrendous. STAY FAR FAR AWAY FROM THIS AIRLINE!!!!
reviews.author: Patrick F

reviews.title: Best flight I’ve had - and I’ve flown a lot
reviews.text: I fly on a monthly basis for work and took a porter flight to Vancouver instead of air Canada for the first time - it was one of the best experiences I’ve had on a plane - great food - great staff - incredibly relaxing and on time :)! Would 100% recommend
reviews.author: Sam C

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Flew the first time with them and was pleasantly surprised.They provide snacks even for an hour flight and they serve you drinks in glasses and not plastic caps.
reviews.author: elen710

reviews.title: First time, won't be the last!
reviews.text: This was our first time flying with Porter after having heard many positive reviews. Our flights left on time. Check in was very easy. Prices were cheaper than WJ and AC. Flying out of BIlly Bishop is so much easier than flying out of Pearson. Snacks and refreshments were great (and free).
reviews.author: PBinBurlington

reviews.title: Avoid Porter Airlines
reviews.text: I recently had my first and last experience with Porter. First, my flight was delayed by 2 hours, then another 2 hours. When we were finally told to board we directed to a hallway where we stood approximately another hour before we were informed that our flight was canceled. We were told it was a "controllable event" because the pilot had "timed out." We were booked on a flight the next day and informed that we would be reimbursed for hotel and meal expenses that night. In fact, some passengers were transported to a hotel at Porter's expense. We chose our own accommodations. When we applied for reimbursement we were told that we were ineligible because the flight cancellation was uncontrollable. How could the cancellation be due to a "controllable event" and some passengers receive hotel, meal and travel accommodations and other passengers on the same flight be told it was an "uncontrollable event" and be denied reimbursement? The entire experience was horrendous because we were given no information during the delays while Porter employees basically ordered us around like cattle during the entire process. Then we were told we would be reimbursed for overnight expenses, yet denied when we filed for them. There are so many alternatives available, no one should subject themselves to the aggravation of dealing with Porter Airlines.
reviews.author: Bill N

reviews.title: Never Again - A Nightmare
reviews.text: A “10-hour” trip turned into a 32-hour debacle. Our 78 year old mother-in-law was left stranded in the airport overnight - no updates, no details. At 5am, they finally “cancelled” her flight and gave her a hotel room but she hadn’t slept all night. Flew out the next day but missed her connecting flight so spent ANOTHER night in a hotel. Only 4 hours sleep, she finally arrived home 32 hours after she left. Porter was disorganized, confused, basically awful. Never again.
reviews.author: Jennifer F

reviews.title: No place to go and no information to work wit
reviews.text: Never again…..Airport socked in,no flights in or out…advised updates hourly didn’t happen…was told at desk too busy…told them that’s because no update….board did not reflect delays and once my flight time passed flight disappeared from board…back to desk where was told don’t know what but flight still delayed…only flight to Chicago that day so no relief….so after 5 hours of no information and no estimate of take off time ,got a refund and …left….never again…if there is a aPorter of other problems no options…had to go home and miss the wedding I was to attend in Chicago….lastly cost me $90 for taxi home which Porter refused to cover…..
reviews.author: Larry V

reviews.title: Disappointing Experience with Porter Airlines - A One Star Review
reviews.text: I am writing this review to share my recent experience with Porter Airlines, which was nothing short of disappointing. I strongly advise potential customers to consider other airlines before choosing Porter, as their disregard for customer welfare and comfort was shockingly evident in my experience. My flight, along with two senior citizens, one of whom is in poor health, was delayed by 27 hours. While such delays can be understandable, the airline's response to our predicament was not. There was no attempt made by Porter to provide any form of compensation, leaving us stranded and out of pocket in Toronto. When I reached out to their customer service for assistance, I was offered no help in finding accommodation for the night. Instead, the representative shockingly suggested that we sleep on the floor of the airport. This lack of basic empathy and respect for passengers, especially seniors and those in poor health, was deeply distressing and unacceptable. I have traveled with several airlines and this is the first time I have encountered such a lack of responsibility towards passengers. The experience left us not only financially burdened but also feeling disrespected and undervalued. Therefore, I strongly recommend considering other airlines that prioritize their customers' comfort and well-being. I believe that travel should be a pleasant experience, and unfortunately, Porter Airlines fell drastically short of providing this. It's a 1-star rating from me and a strong recom
reviews.author: Adventurer817844

reviews.title: What happened to this airline
reviews.text: When I first starting taking Porter it was great! On time, comfy seats, good staff. Took it again for first time in 2 years and WOW DO THEY SUCK! Cancelled flight 45 minutes before without explanation (par for most airlines) but the real surprise was the seats and plain itself! The seats are basically lawn chairs with a cover on them, they don't recline at all and it is like sitting on jagged bars. The staff are burnt and don't care about their job, it is obvious, there is no customer service. I got off of a 45 minute flight feeling as if I had pulled an all nighter sitting in a box, and I'm short! Honestly, I'd rather take awful Air Canada over this two bit operation...after my experience I don't even trust they can keep planes in the sky!
reviews.author: CharlesSe

reviews.title: Best flight ever
reviews.text: Excellent service , friendly staff, complimentary alcohol drinks, snacks , they even serve meals on sucha short flight. Air Canada and the others should learn from this company but they are too greedy.
reviews.author: Chris O

reviews.title: Best flight of my life
reviews.text: I've flown over 200+ times and have to say the E195-E2 (PD360) from Calgary to Toronto on May 14th was the best flight I've ever taken in my life! From the incredible staff, comfy seats, free wifi, alcohol and food to the freakish quietness and smoothness of the plane I just felt so comfortable, satisfied and safe the entire time. I can't recommend this plane and crew enough. Will be flying the Porter E2 for all North American trips going forward. Forgot to mention it was also SUPER cheap! What's there not to like!
reviews.author: Chad L

reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text: This is by far the worst Airline in Canada. The customer service is absolutely terrible… if I could give it negative stars, I would
reviews.author: Larry F

reviews.title: Unable to contact
reviews.text: Booked tickets from Australia, still in Australia. Recieved no reply email to contact them as flight cancelled and they want to reschedule . Keep trying to ring, get cut off. Even a return email address would be great
reviews.author: Joanne A
